source: NHTSA vehicle crash-test database (nrd.api.nhtsa.dot.gov get-multimedia-files) photo listings; photos from nrd-static.nhtsa.dot.gov (photos/vehdb and vehdb/<test>/photos), chosen by file name (scripts/nhtsa_photo_select.py), resized to WebP (fit 960x720 and 320x240, no metadata) by scripts/build-nhtsa-photos.py. Keys from the vPIC decode of each test vehicle's VIN (data-src/test-vehicle-specs.jsonl, tire-placards.jsonl).
